notes.title: Update 0.9.0
notes.content:
We've made a few changes and added Leaderboards in this update. You can now compete for high scores in the Town Defense and Multiplayer COOP game modes!

Additionally snowballs now grow in size as they roll in the snow :)

notes.title: Update 0.8.9
notes.content:
New and fixed items:

[list]
[*] Player avatar sizes in build mode (extra cute)
[*] Updated some sound effects
[*] Added progression locking to fortress levels
[*] More blocks when building in PVP
[*] Fixed scoring in multiplayer
[*] Added snow to snow globes
[*] Added descriptions to game modes in main menu
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.8
notes.content:
We've fixed up the following:

Snow Globes in the main menu cabin fall when released
Fixed ghost respawning avatar visuals in multiplayer
Updated controller help and tips for Oculus controllers
Added translations for controller help images

We've also added a new "Platform Block" in creative mode to build roofs and floors.

notes.title: Snow Fortress 2 - Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25282816/6bf6e9bbf7fd75518718e476e606e8226bc61abd.jpg[/img]
The time has come to don your virtual mittens and step into a winter wonderland once again. We are thrilled to announce the launch of [b]Snow Fortress 2[/b] – the much-anticipated sequel to your favorite VR snowball fighting game!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2433960/Snow_Fortress_2/]Visit Snow Fortress 2 on Steam[/url]

[previewyoutube=lmXxYFJVJIo;full][/previewyoutube]

For those who spent hours building forts and fending off snowy foes in the original Snow Fortress, get ready for an even more exhilarating experience. [b]Snow Fortress 2[/b] takes the frosty battles to a whole new level, with enhanced mechanics and even more exciting features:

[list]
[*] Enhanced Fort-Building: Dive into more creative and robust fort-building mechanics. Whether you fancy constructing a formidable igloo or a towering ice castle, the choice is yours!
[*] Bigger Battles: Face an army of snowmen with new strategies and quick reflexes!
[*] More Weapons, More Fun: The snowball fight gets a major upgrade. From your trusty hand-packed snowballs to the powerful Snow Cannon, you're equipped for the ultimate showdown.
[*] Expanded Multiplayer Experience: Team up or compete with friends in improved coop, PVP and creative multiplayer modes. 
[/list]

[b]Snow Fortress 2[/b] is available now for crossplay on Steam, Quest App Lab, and Pico platforms.

Our journey from the first Snow Fortress game to this sequel has been incredible, and it's all thanks to your support and love for the game. We've poured our hearts into making Snow Fortress 2 an unforgettable experience, keeping the charm of the original while introducing exciting new elements.

So, what are you waiting for? Grab your VR headset and jump back into the snowy fray. We can't wait to see the incredible forts you'll build and defend in Snow Fortress 2!

STAY FROSTY!

-JJ & The Mythical City Games team
